name: Vaporsoft
note: Machine-readable mirror of the CSS custom properties. global.css is what ships and is authoritative; scripts/check-palette.mjs fails if the two disagree, or if any brand SVG uses a hex outside this file.

carmine.role: The only accent. Never substituted, never approximated.

atmosphere.note: Stops of the fixed background gradient, top to bottom. Not for foreground use.

ramp.note: Anchored on carmine, roughly constant luminance ratio (~1.6) between stops. Used by the CRISPR disc. Shades read on light grounds, tints on dark.

live.role: Status dot for a running service. Signal only — not a brand colour, never decorative.

retired.note: Values that shipped before 2026-09-16 and are wrong anywhere they appear. The check script rejects them on sight. #f7f3ed is absent deliberately: it is a valid atmosphere stop in CSS, it was only wrong as an icon plate, where the surface value belongs.

svg.note: A brand SVG may only use these. Derived, not a separate list to maintain: the four core values, the two theme grounds and surfaces, and the ramp. Anything else in public/brand/**.svg fails the check.
